govt_considered.verdict: KEPT by the gate and RESEARCHED - the name chosen (Premier Explosives) was NOT published. Three reasons, in order of weight. The stock closed at Rs 631.10 today, 11.8% BELOW the offer. (2) The AoN list itself could not be read: pib.gov.in is refused at this sandbox's egress proxy, govt.json carries only the title and the outlay, and the item-level detail exists in this run only as press reports, which are not primary. Without the list, materiality to this company's specific programmes cannot be proved from its own documents, which the playbook requires. (3) Earnings are going the wrong way into a 74x trailing multiple: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 102.56 cr (-27.9% YoY) and PAT Rs 3.03 cr (-80.2% YoY), against FY26 PAT of Rs 45.83 cr on a market capitalisation of Rs 3,392.87 cr. And an AoN is in-principle approval, not an order - the 2026-09-22 study's own lesson is that the question is whose ORDER BOOK the money lands in, and that the baskets' bases came MONTHS after the announcement, so there is time to research this properly rather than publish on day one.
govt_considered.exposure_read: For the record, Premier's exposure IS documented and strong - from its FY26 annual report, read this run: FY26 revenue from operations Rs 388.34 cr of which Defence and Space contributed Rs 315.4 cr = 81%, Commercial Explosives Rs 72.9 cr; order book Rs 1,569 cr as of May 2026 = 4.04x FY26 revenue with ~95% from defence; it supplies booster grains, sustainer grains, solid propellants, pyrogen igniters and rocket motors to the Akash, MRSAM, LRSAM, Astra, Agni and BrahMos programmes, and is 'the only qualified Indian company for countermeasures' (chaff and flares). That is exactly the profile a VSHORADS / naval-decoy / counter-drone round should favour. It is the price and the takeover, not the exposure, that keep it off the page.

researched.name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
researched.reason: H1 FY27 filed today. Group revenue Rs 238.82 cr (+116.2% YoY), group EBITDA Rs 60.81 cr (+159.5%, 25.5% margin), group PAT Rs 24.85 cr (+126.6%), basic EPS Rs 6.25; STANDALONE - the organic read - revenue Rs 49.19 cr (+83.6%) at a 55.3% EBITDA margin and PAT Rs 13.97 cr (+79.4%). Open enterprise pipeline Rs 920 cr across 77 deals in 16 countries, 65% beyond supply-chain finance and 84% outside India. Standalone DSO down 149 -> 135 -> 99 -> 88 days. Market cap Rs 626.5 cr at a close of Rs 245.30 is about 20x annualised H1 FY27 basic EPS. Main-board migration approved by BSE, NSE awaited. WHAT KEEPS THE CONFIDENCE LOW, all from the FY26 annual report and the Q4 FY26 call: about 73% of FY26 consolidated revenue of Rs 345.13 cr came from outside the core product perimeter (management's own build: standalone Rs 71 cr + Estorifi/GlobeTF Rs 21 cr = Rs 91.75 cr, plus Rs 253 cr of other entities); standalone intangibles Rs 261.49 cr against full-year standalone amortisation of only Rs 8.88 cr, with the company itself listing 'Capitalised product-development risk'; consolidated goodwill Rs 328.25 cr plus intangibles Rs 400.81 cr = Rs 729 cr of a Rs 1,004.89 cr balance sheet; cash fell (standalone to Rs 1.52 cr from Rs 6.67 cr, consolidated to Rs 15.24 cr from Rs 42.99 cr) while receivables rose to Rs 133.13 cr from Rs 49.65 cr; Rs 50 cr of NCDs taken in August; promoters hold only 34.73% and filed two 'reasons for encumbrance' disclosures in August whose PDFs are IMAGE-ONLY so the pledged quantity is unread; and the FY26 report records that arbitration proceedings cost the company effective control of Epikindifi Software. AND ONE DISCLOSURE THE CARD STATES PLAINLY: pages 4-9 and 13-19 of today's signed results PDF are scanned images with zero extractable text and BSE's structured results feed had not ingested the quarter, so every figure comes from the company's own earnings presentation filed the same day, not from the signed statement's tables.

researched.name: Cosmic CRF Ltd
researched.reason: Both order letters opened. Rs 2,112.20 lakh to the parent and Rs 1,234.10 lakh to subsidiary N.S. Engineering Projects Pvt Ltd - total Rs 33.46 cr - and the letters say 'Gross Order Value (Inclusive of GST)', so ex-GST at 18% it is about Rs 28.4 cr. Execution 'within 2 months'; the subsidiary's order is 1,300 MT of fabricated MS steel items. Four things rule it out on the measured rules. (1) SIZE AGAINST SALES, which is the test that works: Rs 33.46 cr gross is about 10% of FY26 revenue of Rs 333.9 cr - the under-10%-of-sales bucket, measured at a 21.4% chance of 2x in two years against 35.7% for the 25-50% bucket. (2) RARITY, the other half of the study: this is not a rare filer. In the 240-day announcement list read this run Cosmic CRF filed THIRTEEN order announcements (26-Oct x2, 25-Sep x2, 22-Sep, 19-Sep x3, 08-Sep x2, 15-Jul x2, 14-Jul) - the 8+-prior-filings bucket, measured at 17.3% for 2x and NEVER 5x. (3) CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION AND CUSTOMER CREDIT: both orders are from the same customer, Jai Balaji Industries Ltd - and Jai Balaji's own BSE filing of 23-Sep-2026, read this run, carries CRISIL's rationale downgrading it to 'Crisil BBB/Stable' from 'BBB+/Stable' and short-term to A3+ from A2 on Rs 995 cr of facilities, because FY26 revenue fell 8% to Rs 5,786 cr and DI-pipe capacity utilisation collapsed to ~30% from 80%. (4) The stock is -32.4% in a month and closed at its 65-day window LOW today. Worth keeping on the watch list: FY26 revenue Rs 333.9 cr and PAT Rs 26.29 cr are both up three years running, promoter holding rose to 56.54% from 54.76% a year ago, and there is a July-2026 Letter of Intent naming the company a 'Successful Resolution Applicant' that was not investigated this run.
